# FoundRy agent entry point

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for canonical repository instructions and
[the collaboration protocol](../docs/agent-collaboration.md) before cross-host work.

Prefer a small, explicitly assigned task or narrow diff review within the owner's
limited Copilot allocation. Confirm ownership and file scope, inspect current Git
state, preserve other agents' work, and return the compact handoff with exact
commit and validation evidence. Do not duplicate an active Replit assignment.
